runtimeSplitCheck.followUp: Since you're looking at this from a cost and configuration angle, are you currently seeing unexplained spikes in your logs, or are you mapping out the projected costs for a new high-traffic launch?
runtimeSplitCheck.text:
The Tradeoff: High responsiveness increases conversion, but it increases the operation count.
Most teams find the sweet spot by debouncing at 100-300ms.
